policy: Every corrected behavior carries exactly one bug ID. Status 'reproduced' requires an executed pinned-reference run recorded under evidence/. Status 'hypothesis' requires confirmation with a minimal failing input before corrected_v1 implements a fix. 'registered_unsupported' records pinned broken paths that parity must not silently include; corrected_v1 may repair them under their ID.

bugs.title: betweenness per-origin diagnostics crash and d_graph poisoning with closest_destination=True
bugs.mechanism: eligible_destinations_shortest_distance is bound only in the Huff (closest_destination=False) branch; the stats block dereferences it unconditionally. UnboundLocalError is caught by a bare except whose handler `continue`s, skipping remove_node_to_graph, so processed origins remain inserted in the shared d_graph for subsequent origins.
bugs.evidence: campaigns/una_platform/evidence/tasks/FAILURES (3x3 grid run, 2026-09-30: UnboundLocalError for every origin; betweenness bytes deterministic under seed; graph poisoning visible in scope)
bugs.intended_rule: per-origin diagnostics complete without exception and every inserted origin is removed from the working graph after processing
bugs.corrected_v1_action: compute closest/furthest destination distances on the closest-destination branch as well; always remove the origin in a finally path
bugs.legacy_disposition: madina_legacy reproduces the defective behavior bit-for-bit on valid inputs (it is the pinned reference)
bugs.migration: corrected_v1 users see full diagnostics columns and unchanged graph state; documented in bug_deltas.json
